configuration.loss: completion-only cross-entropy, mean over completion tokens of one example; an update averages the 4 per-example means (PRERUN D4)
configuration.optimizer: mlx.optimizers.Adam (installed defaults: betas [0.9, 0.999], eps 1e-8, bias_correction False), constant learning rate

resource_monitor.note: discrete samples after load, each warm-up and each request; not a continuous peak guarantee

update_seconds_definition: MLX-LM 0.32.2 trainer compute time of the update's micro-steps (forward, backward, optimizer update, mx.eval, cache clearing), summed between its perf_counter marks; excludes batch construction, the progress display and everything in the callback (evaluation, adapter saves, resource sampling, records); the first window includes graph compilation
